title: China's GPU Landscape Gains a New Powerhouse: Moerlian Successfully Runs Open-Source Giant Model with 2.8 Trillion Parameters on Kimi K3 MUSA Stack
excerpt: A message indicating successful adaptation has added another card to the domestic computing power alliance that can support trillion-parameter models. Moirai Te
content_html:
A message indicating successful adaptation has added another card to the domestic computing power alliance that can support trillion-parameter models. Moirai Technologies announced that with the official open-source release of the Kimi K3 model, which has a parameter scale of 2.8 trillion, along with the release of model weights and technical reports, the company has completed the ultra-fast adaptation of Kimi K3 and stably launched it using its AI training and inference integrated smart computing card MTT S5000 and MUSA software stack.

The MTT S5000 is Moirai Technologies' main training and inference integrated smart computing card, while MUSA is its self-developed software ecosystem foundation, equivalent to translating chip computing power into language that developers can directly use. Together, they have firmly supported the newly open-sourced Kimi K3, meaning another domestic GPU has joined the ranks capable of running ultra-large-scale open-source models. As each domestic chip gradually overcomes the threshold of trillions of parameters, the landscape of large model computing power is quietly being rewritten.

一则适配成功的消息，为国内算力联盟又添了一张可支持万亿参数模型的牌。 Moirai Technologies宣布，随着参数规模达2.8万亿的Kimi K3模型正式开源，并发布模型权重和技术报告，公司已完成Kimi K3的超快适配，并利用其AI训练推理一体智能计算卡MTT S5000和MUSA软件栈稳定上线。

MTT S5000是Moirai Technologies主打的训练与推理一体化智能计算卡，而MUSA则是其自研的软件生态基础，相当于将芯片算力转化为开发者可以直接使用的语言。 他们共同坚定支持新开源的Kimi K3，这意味着又一个国产GPU加入了能够运行超大规模开源模型的行列。 随着每颗国产芯片逐渐攻克万亿参数门槛，大模型算力的格局正在悄然被改写。
